description: Check an async doseedo task once. Returns current status, and the result (file URLs / notes) when finished.

job_id.description: Alternatively the job_id (job_…) from a submit tool or the jobs API — replaces task_id + kind.

kind.description: Which job kind created the task — the registry name the submit reply carried (generate_music, render_midi, cover_song, separate_stems, transcribe, audio_to_session, convert_project, bounce_session, analyze_song, detect_chords, beat_grid, analyze_midi); the short codes (generate, render, cover, separate, session, convert, bounce, analyze, chords, beats, harmony) are accepted aliases.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by a submit tool.

name: doseedo_check_task
